log_file.description: Path to the log file for the Inspector service.

log_dir.description: Directory where log files are stored.

log_level.description: Logging level: debug, info, warning, error, or critical.

debug.description: Enable debug mode for verbose logging.

api_host.description: IP address or hostname to bind the Inspector API server.

api_port.description: Port number for the Inspector API server.

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for the Inspector API.

api_cert_file.description: Path to the TLS certificate file for the Inspector API (if TLS enabled).

api_cert_key_file.description: Path to the TLS private key file for the Inspector API.

api_ca_cert_file.description: Path to the CA certificate for validating client TLS certificates.

keystone_project_name.description: OpenStack project (tenant) name for the Inspector service account.

keystone_username.description: Service account username for authenticating to Keystone.

keystone_password.description: Password for the service account. Must be set to a secure value.

keystone_region_name.description: OpenStack region name where services are deployed (optional).

keystone_auth_type.description: Authentication type: 'password' or 'token' (rarely used for service accounts).

keystone_service_token.description: Shared secret token used for service-to-service authentication (only if auth_type='token').

db_max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries to reconnect to the database on startup.

ironic_project_name.description: Project name used to authenticate to Ironic.

ironic_username.description: Username for the Ironic service account.

ironic_password.description: Password for the Ironic service account.

ironic_service_token.description: Service token used for token-based auth to Ironic (optional).

ironic_insecure.description: Disable SSL certificate verification when connecting to Ironic (not recommended in production).

ironic_cafile.description: CA certificate file to verify Ironic server certs (if insecure=false).

dhcp_provider.description: DHCP provider: 'neutron' or 'none' (to disable DHCP provisioning).

neutron_url.description: Neutron API endpoint URL (used if dhcp_provider=neutron).

neutron_project_id.description: Project (tenant) ID for Neutron operations (e.g., port management).

neutron_auth_url.description: Keystone auth URL used by the Inspector for Neutron auth.

allow_overwrite.description: Allow overwriting existing PXE boot files for nodes.

extra_hooks.description: List of extra Python module paths for processing hooks (e.g., custom introspection logic).

ports_to_open.description: Comma-separated list of UDP/TCP ports to open in security groups (e.g., for PXE/DHCP).

node_cleanup.description: Automatically clean up nodes in 'inspect' state after a timeout.

cleanup_delay.description: Time (seconds) before cleaning up nodes left in 'inspect' state.

power_off.description: Power off nodes after successful introspection.

power_off_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for node to power off.

event_notifications.description: Send Nova events on introspection completion (for scheduling integration).

metrics_notifications.description: Send Ceilometer metrics (deprecated in favor of Telemetry).

notification_level.description: Minimum level for sending notifications: 'INFO', 'WARNING', or 'ERROR'.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable TLS for internal services (e.g., ironic client TLS).

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to server certificate for TLS.

ssl_key_file.description: Path to private key for TLS.

ssl_ca_file.description: Path to CA certificate for TLS verification.

store_data.description: Store raw introspection data for debugging and analysis.

data_dir.description: Directory for storing introspection data files.

hooks_enabled.description: Enable hook-based processing pipeline during introspection.

power_on_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for powering on a node before giving up.

ipmi_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for IPMI commands (e.g., PXE boot wait).

node_present_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for a node to appear in Ironic after being registered.

discovery_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) allowed for the entire introspection process.
